summary: Constructing a bound function must forward construction to its target, prepend bound arguments, ignore bound this, and preserve new.target transparency.

target.notes: Bound [[Construct]] calls the target constructor. When newTarget is the bound function itself, the effective newTarget becomes the target.

semantics.new_target: transparent when directly constructing bound function

caveats: A bound function whose target is not constructable is itself not constructable.
Bound functions lack an own prototype property but may still be constructable.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Bound Function Exotic Objects

tests.name: new.target transparent
tests.input: function C(){return new.target}; const B=C.bind(null); console.log(new B()===C);

tests.name: bound args prepended
tests.input: function C(a,b){this.v=a+b}; const B=C.bind(null,2); console.log(new B(3).v);
